name: CLIENT_ID
label: OAuth client ID
setupSteps: In the Canva Developer Portal, create a new integration and make it Private, so members of your Canva team can connect. A Public one can't pass Canva's review, because design generation and background removal are preview APIs.
Under Authentication, add the redirect URL below.
Under Scopes, enable the scopes this gatekeeper requests: design:meta:read, design:content:write, asset:read, asset:write, folder:read, profile:read.
Copy the integration's Client ID here, then generate a Client Secret and copy that below.
